status: protocol: frozen before any uncertainty score is computed; the Stage A code lands in its own PR, implementing these rules
exploratory: the development starts' outcomes were seen in B1 (#59); Stage A decides only whether a third member is trained

members.normalizer: both checkpoints' preprocessor and postprocessor stats are byte-identical (asserted), so actions compare in one normalized space

inventory.b1_kept: per-episode sum and max reward, success and start seed; videos of the first 10 episodes per seed
inventory.b1_missing: observations, simulator states, actions and policy outputs
inventory.consequence: one read-only evaluation rerun from the pinned checkpoints; nothing is reconstructed from summaries or videos

rerun.episode: env.reset(seed = start), gym_pusht as lerobot-eval makes it (environment_state_agent_pos, 300 steps), ending at success or step 300
rerun.driving: stage_b2.Policy: the checkpoint and its own processors, as lerobot-eval drives it
rerun.driver_chunk_seed: SeedSequence([62, driver, start, chunk]); torch is seeded before each 16-action chunk
rerun.recorded: every step's observation, full simulator state, action and coverage; every chunk's 16 outputs
rerun.reconciliation: each driver's rerun average maximum coverage and success against B1's are reported as a measurement, not a gate (#53); failure labels come from the rerun alone

uncertainty.decision_points: every chunk boundary of the driver's rollout (steps 0, 8, 16, ...), at the driver's two-frame observation
uncertainty.shared_noise: at a decision point, torch is seeded with SeedSequence([62, 0, driver, start, chunk]) before each member generates one batch of 16 chunks, so every member denoises the same 16 noise draws
uncertainty.coordinates: the policy's normalized action space (min/max to [-1, 1])
uncertainty.slots: the executed slots, horizon indices 1-8 (n_obs_steps - 1 onward)
uncertainty.U_epi: mean over the 16 samples of the variance across members, averaged over slots 1-8 and both action dimensions
uncertainty.U_ale: mean over members of the variance across the 16 samples, averaged over slots 1-8 and both action dimensions
uncertainty.reported: U_epi, U_ale and U_epi / U_ale at every decision point

labels.failure: the driver's rerun episode does not reach gym_pusht success (coverage > 0.95) within 300 steps

aggregation.early_window: the decision points before step 80 (the first 10 chunks); a successful episode contributes those before its success
aggregation.episode_score: mean U_epi over the early window
aggregation.state_score: U_epi at each early-window decision point, labelled with its episode's outcome
aggregation.why_early: a failed episode runs all 300 steps and a successful one stops early, so whole-episode means confound disagreement with duration and stalled states

discrimination.statistic: rank AUC (Mann-Whitney, ties counted half) of failed over successful episodes

decision.pass: on each driver separately: the episode-level AUC of U_epi is at least 0.70, and it exceeds the AUC of U_ale under the same aggregation
decision.minimum_classes: at least 10 failed and 10 successful episodes per driver, or Stage A refuses as uninformative
decision.fail: publish and stop; no other formula, noise schedule, window, horizon or threshold is tried

descriptive: U_epi and U_ale distributions, by outcome
state-level AUC in the early window
U_epi by chunk index, failed against successful, over the whole episode
U_epi for successful episodes by steps before success
whole-episode mean U_epi AUC (not a gate)

audit.policy: every driver chunk and probe batch is regenerated bit for bit from the saved observations and seeds in a fresh process
audit.recomputed: U_epi, U_ale, labels, aggregation and every AUC are recomputed from the saved outputs and must be identical
audit.simulator_replay: an independent replay of the saved actions is a measurement, not an equality gate (#50)

starts.note: no study or earlier smoke uses them

smoke.identity_control: a member probed against itself with the shared noise gives U_epi = 0 exactly
smoke.checks: byte-identical rerun, the fresh-process audit, and injected faults (a changed probe output, a changed label, a moved decision point)

reserved_for_stage_b.note: unused by any earlier stage; Stage B freezes its own rule in its own protocol PR, only if Stage A passes
